# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from datetime import date

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Doe", "Jane", "A")


def _mark(ident, when, status):
    return Mark(ident, when, status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_sorted_absences(self):
        marks = [
            _mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 5), "absent"),
            _mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 4), "present"),
            _mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent")
        ]
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertEqual(
            text,
            "Jane Doe missed 2 day(s): 2026-03-02, 2026-03-05."
        )

    def test_other_student(self):
        marks = [_mark("s2", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        marks = [_mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 2), "late")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
